assets.name: SovietInfantry01_seated
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production transparent top-down seated tank-rider infantry sprite. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET for exact seated pose, proportions, placement and canvas framing. Image 2 is Soviet soldier IDENTITY, PALETTE and WEAPON reference. Replace ONLY image 1's soldier identity/equipment to match image 2. Preserve image 1's strictly 90-degree directly overhead camera, helmet hides entire face/chest, shoulders and two bent short thighs/knees with tiny boots; clearly SITTING with legs toward bottom, not standing or squatting. Keep EXACT same head size, shoulder width, thigh lengths, silhouette footprint, padding and full canvas aspect as image 1. Hips centered at x=50%, y=61% from top. Khaki-olive Soviet uniform, darker desaturated olive smooth steel helmet, brown leather straps, muted khaki small pack. Match image 2's muted darker palette, no bright yellow highlights. Thick near-black outlines, very coarse simplified pixel blocks, just a few big shadows, minimal detail, readability at 24px. Exactly TWO hands, one anatomical left and one right, attached to sleeves, gripping weapon across lap. Gun is horizontal, muzzle points image RIGHT, full gun straight as a ruler with receiver/barrel/shroud/muzzle on ONE horizontal axis, no bends or diagonal kink. Keep shoulders and legs unchanged to match pose template. No face, text, scene, ground, tank, cast shadow, panel or checkerboard matte. Genuine transparent alpha background. One Soviet rifleman with wood-stock Mosin-style bolt-action rifle held HORIZONTALLY across lap. Straight thin dark steel barrel, simple long brown wood stock. Use compact proportions and horizontal pose of image 1.
